title: Bush and LBJ briefed on JFK assassination at Clint Murchison's ranch

tellings.quote: he was he was in a meeting at the ranch of Clint merchon is where not the one in Waka but the one in Dallas

plain: In 1963, George H. W. Bush and Lyndon Johnson were, in this account, briefed on the assassination of John F. Kennedy at a meeting on the ranch of a man named Clint Murchison, the one in Dallas, the teller stresses, not the one near Waco. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells it on the show as something passed on to him, and J. Edgar Hoover is named among those tied to the story. If true, two future presidents would have been told something about the killing in private.
